properties.name: Freewheel San Francisco / Bay Area query/clip boundary (DRAFT)
properties.coordinate_order: [lon, lat] (RFC 7946) — the OPPOSITE of sf_canon.yaml's [lat, lon]
properties.note: DRAFT clip polygon covering the nine-county San Francisco Bay Area: SF city, Marin County (Point Reyes to Mill Valley/Sausalito), East Bay (Richmond through Fremont/Newark), Peninsula (Pacifica through San Jose south), and the South Bay (Cupertino/San Jose). Every vertex lies within the SF bounds guard (lat 36.9-38.2, lon -123.0..-121.5). This is the QUERY/CLIP boundary, not the routing extent — a self-hosted ORS/Valhalla graph must cover the bbox of ALL stored route geometry, which can extend beyond this polygon. Verify against the chosen canon ride extents before a production run.
